title: "GitHub App" is GitHub's product name for an app installed on repositories: keep it.
intro: Coding sessions are AI coding agents' sessions. "Coding → Repositories" names a settings page: keep it matching the Settings nav.
repositoryPlaceholder: Format hint in an empty field: a GitHub repository as owner/name. Keep the slash; you may translate the two words.
repositoryInvalid: "owner/name" and "acme/app" show the format: keep the slash.
ownerFrom: Toast after saving: {{repository}} is the repository, such as acme/app.
useDefault: Button: use the repository the server's environment sets instead.
status.unreadable: {{name}} is the GitHub App's short name or number; {{account}} the GitHub account or organization it is installed on. The _env forms add that the App comes from the server's environment (GITHUB_APP_ID, an environment variable). "Disconnect" and "Connect GitHub" are this card's buttons: keep them matching.
explain: "Create" and "Install" are buttons on GitHub's own pages, in English. Coding agents are AI agents that write code.
needsOrigin: APP_ORIGIN is an environment variable name: keep it.
disconnectNote: "Developer settings → GitHub Apps" names GitHub's own settings pages, in English.
